telegram._help: Get free bot from @BotFather on Telegram. Leave blank to disable.

distance._help_threshold: Alert fires only when person is closer than this distance (meters).
distance._help_focal: Camera focal length in pixels. 700 is typical for 1080p webcam. Increase if distances read too low, decrease if too high.
distance._help_height: Assumed real-world height of a person in meters (used for distance estimation).
